attachments.origin_landmark: adjacent metatarsal shafts (each with 2 heads, bipennate)
attachments.insertion_landmark: extensor expansion + proximal phalanx base, digits 2 (both sides), 3, 4

actions: abduct toes away from the axial line (digit 2, the foot's reference axis, unlike the hand's digit 3)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: 4 separate small bipennate muscles (TA: interossei dorsales pedis I-IV), the foot's structural analog of the hand's dorsal interossei, but referenced to digit 2 rather than digit 3 since the foot's functional axis runs through the 2nd toe.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
